about: Two Ghostbusters trapped in the portrait-room doorway on the original disk (C64 Preservation Project G64, side 1), from the start of the museum with joystick port 2 and Space only. Replayed in VICE on 17 November 2026 with kit/c64/vice.py: one entry is held for its frames, then released.
start: The museum's rope scene on the original disk, the first Ghostbuster at the top of the rope: Ghostbuster 1 at X 80, Ghostbuster 2 not yet on the floor (Y 42 for both). The episodes before it were passed by setting the program counter to the airshaft's success path ($0897) and Broadway's ($C9D5); see orientation.md.

inputs.note: Ghostbuster 1 down the rope: lands at X 80, Y 176
Ghostbuster 2 down the rope: lands at X 128, Y 176, and is the one controlled
through the doorway: room 1 (the portrait room), X 64, Y 116
through the doorway: room 1, X 64, Y 116, on top of Ghostbuster 2

observed.trapped: From that state, holding each direction for 60 frames moved neither Ghostbuster: Ghostbuster 1 up, down, left and right, then Space and Ghostbuster 2 the same. Both stayed at X 64, Y 116 in room 1, and were still there after 300 more frames.
observed.cracked: With the cracked copy's eight JMPs poked over the checks at $B7FB, $B911, $BA0A, $BB5F, $BC92, $BD79, $BE43 and $BF69 in the same state, Ghostbuster 1 walked down 20 frames to Y 156 and Ghostbuster 2 up 20 frames to Y 76.
observed.cadence: With the checks skipped, 10 frames of up reached the first Ghostbuster's up check 20 times and moved him 20 lines; 10 frames of right reached his right check 10 times and moved him 20 pixels.
